category_description: Registered accounts for saving and investing in Canada, and the limits that apply to them.
subcategory_description: Tax-free and tax-deferred accounts for saving, investing and buying a first home.
label: FHSA participation room in the first year
context: The most that can be contributed or transferred from RRSPs to all of a person's FHSAs combined in the year they open their first FHSA. Later years add any carryforward, within the lifetime limit.

label: FHSA lifetime limit
context: Contributions and transfers from RRSPs to a person's FHSAs cannot take their total participation room beyond this amount over the life of the accounts.

subject_intro: Who can open a first home savings account, how much room there is each year and over a lifetime, how withdrawals for a first home work, and when the account has to close.
subject_meta_description: An FHSA helps first-time buyers save for a home. Room is {fact:ca_fhsa_annual} a year with a {fact:ca_fhsa_lifetime} lifetime limit. See who qualifies and how withdrawals work.
